label: melanoma
caption_gt: Histopathology showing spindle cell uveal melanoma from a left eye choroidal pigmented malignant melanoma, classified as invasive in the ciliary body and cornea (stage IIIB, pT4bN0M0). The microscopic examination reveals a dense cell proliferation composed of small and medium fusiform (spindle) cells, along with evident pigment production. The tissue fragments were embedded in paraffin for this histopathological examination. Staining is Hematoxylin–Eosin (HE), magnified ×100.
caption_gen:
The lesion shows atypical melanocytes infiltrating the dermis. There is a prominent pigment network.
Melanoma. High.
